security packet-filter rule-stat(1)			BIG-IP TMSH Manual		       security packet-filter rule-stat(1)

NAME
       rule-stat - Displays statistics of packet-filter rules on the BIG-IP(r) system. You can only use the show command with this
       component.

MODULE
       security packet-filter

SYNTAX
	show rule-stat
	  options:
	    (default | exa | gig | kil | meg | peta | raw | tera | yotta | zetta)
	    field-fmt

DESCRIPTION
       You can use the rule-stat component to display statistics of packet-filter rules.

EXAMPLES
       show rule-stat

       Displays packet-filter rule's statistics in the system default units.

       show rule-stat raw

       Displays raw packet-filter rule's statistics.

SEE ALSO
       show, tmsh
